error.assessment_values: Specify the assessment of the intention.
error.assessment_values_outcome: The outcome is not one of the accepted ones.
error.assessment_values_open: Whether the intention is open is set explicitly: open or closed.
error.assessment_values_empty: Set the outcome or whether the intention is open.
error.assessment_exists: This link already has an assessment: correct it instead of adding another.
error.assessment_deleted: The assessment was deleted: restore it before correcting it.
error.assessment_canceled: This assessment was withdrawn: assess again, there is nothing to restore.
error.evidence_kind: An assessment belongs only to a “result for” link.
error.evidence_kind_retarget: Only a “result for” link can have its target corrected.
error.evidence_inactive: The link is withdrawn: assess after restoring it or making a new link.
error.evidence_inactive_retarget: The link is withdrawn: only an active link can have its target corrected.
error.evidence_endpoint_same: The fact and the intention must be different records.
error.fact_role: The source of a result must be a fact, not an intention.
error.fact_undated: Assessing through a fact needs the event's date.
error.intention_role: The target of a result must be an intention.
error.relation_blocked: The record stays a fact while it is linked as the result of an intention: withdraw the link first.
error.relation_blocked_fact: The record stays an intention while it has results: withdraw the link first.
error.target_linked: This fact already has an active link with the chosen intention: correct the existing links one by one.
error.source_unavailable: The assessment carried over to this link is unavailable; try again later.
error.source_detached: This link refers to an assessment that now belongs to another link: act through the current link.
error.typed_title: A record of a Kind has no separate title.
error.record_fields: A new record needs its capture time, time zone and placement kind.
error.kind_pinned: The Kind and version of a saved record do not change.
error.link_foreign: The link does not belong to the record being saved.
error.intention_time_past: An intention's new date must be in the future; the date can be removed.
error.supplement_orphan: A supplement must belong to one existing record.
error.supplement_orphan_link: A supplement must belong to one existing record: withdraw the supplement itself, not its link.
error.supplement_cardinality: A supplement can have only one original.
error.supplement_placement: A supplement gets no date of its own: it belongs to its original.
error.supplement_relation: A supplement is a completed record, not an intention.
error.supplement_self: A supplement cannot belong to itself.
error.undo_unknown: The action to undo was not found in the journal.
error.undo_unsupported: This action cannot be undone: undo covers editing and deleting a record, withdrawing a link or an assessment, moving an assessment and deleting a Scope.
error.undo_stale: Cannot undo: the record changed after this action.
error.undo_stale_scope: The Scope changed after the deletion being undone.
error.undo_unavailable: The record of the action to undo is unavailable.
error.storage_schema: The storage is not updated to the current Tempience schema ({{path}}). New operations are stopped; the stored data is unchanged.
error.data_space_register: Could not register the local database.
error.data_space_registered: This local database is already registered.
error.data_space_storage: Browser storage is unavailable: the data space cannot be switched.
error.data_space_save: Could not save the chosen data space.
error.data_space_reset_canonical: A scenario reset cannot be applied to the main data.
error.data_space_dismiss_demo: Only the demo can be deleted this way.
error.backup_too_large: This file is larger than {{megabytes}} MB. Files up to {{megabytes}} MB are supported for now.
error.backup_not_json: Could not read the JSON. Choose a file saved through “Export data”.
error.backup_not_export: A JSON file saved through “Export data” is needed.
error.backup_exported_at: The file has no valid export date.
error.backup_label: The file has no valid database name.
error.backup_collections: The set of collections does not match this version of Tempience.
error.backup_collection_array: Collection {{name}} must hold an array of records.
error.backup_collection_ids: Collection {{name}} has a record without an ID or a repeated one.
error.backup_collection_fields: Collection {{name}} has fields unknown to this version of Tempience.
error.backup_scope_reason: A Scope withdrawal reason is allowed only on a Kind membership: {{id}}.
error.backup_link_assessment_missing: Link {{id}} refers to a carried-over assessment that is missing.
error.backup_link_assessment_source: Link {{id}} refers to a carried-over assessment of another source.
error.backup_trace_typing: Malformed typing of record {{id}}: the Kind and the version are set together.
error.backup_trace_version: Record {{id}} refers to a missing Kind version.
error.backup_version_schema: Kind version {{id}} holds no data schema.
error.backup_trace_data: The data of record {{id}} does not match its Kind version: {{detail}}
error.backup_supplement_original: Supplement {{id}} must belong to exactly one existing record.
error.backup_assessment_intention: Assessment {{id}} refers to a missing intention.
error.backup_assessment_fact: Assessment {{id}} refers to a missing fact.
error.backup_assessment_link: Assessment {{id}} refers to a “result for” link that does not exist.
error.backup_assessment_source_link: Carried-over assessment {{id}} refers to a link that does not exist.
error.backup_restore_target: Restoring is possible only into a new local database.
error.backup_not_empty: The database already holds data. Create a separate copy from the file.
error.pairing_server_url: The sync server address is not configured.
error.pairing_server_invalid: The server address must be a full URL, for example https://laptop.your-tailnet.ts.net.
error.pairing_server_insecure: The server address must start with https:// (http:// is allowed only for localhost).
error.pairing_token: The server returned an invalid device token.
error.appearance_format: Unknown format of the shared appearance setting.
error.theme_invalid: Check the theme's name and parameters.
error.appearance_unsupported_local: Unsupported local settings. Use the device reset to replace them.
error.appearance_loading: The appearance storage is still loading.
error.capture_settings_format: Unknown format of the record kinds setting.
error.placement_no_time: The record has no original time.
error.draft_native_input: Unfinished input in a form field: {{path}}
error.form_version_required: Choose a version of the form.
error.themes_unsupported: Some themes have an unsupported format. They are kept unchanged.
error.form_fields_empty: Add at least one field to the form or the group.
error.form_type_changed: To change the type of a published field, add a new field.
error.form_unit_changed: To change the unit of a published field, add a new field.

error.storage_schema_type: The storage is not updated to the current Tempience schema: {{path}} is stored as {{actual}} instead of {{expected}}. New operations are stopped; the stored data is unchanged.
